A row without regions is a holiday in every state and Federal Territory; a row with regions is written only for an entity whose region is listed (the write-public-holidays behaviour matches entity.region), so each entity's calendar carries its own state's holidays, the Ruler's birthday or Federal Territory Day of EA s.60D(1)(a)(iii) among them; an entity without a region receives only the rows without regions. Two holidays on one day in a state are one DOUBLE_HOLIDAY row there. SUBSTITUTE rows apply the EA s.60D(1) proviso (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): a holiday on the state's weekly holiday (Sunday; Friday in Kedah, Kelantan and Terengganu, Holidays Act 1951 s.3) moves to the next working day that is not itself a holiday, given only to an employee who was off on the replaced date (ONLY_IF_OFF_ON_REPLACED_DATE); the second holiday of a DOUBLE_HOLIDAY moves to the next working day for everyone. A holiday on another rest day still raises HOLIDAY_ON_REST_DAY for HR to grant its substitute. The employer grants eleven: the five compulsory ones and six of the remaining gazetted holidays (s.60D(1)(a)), plus every s.8 day (s.60D(1)(b)), by publishing the rows; rows stay unpublished until HR publishes them. No calendar is gazetted beyond 2027 (Jadual Hari Kelepasan Am 2028 not yet published). Sabah and Sarawak rows follow the tables; worksites there are outside this lineage (LABOUR_ORDINANCE_TERRITORY). rules.when: work.days.exists(d, d.worked_hours > 12.0)
rules.message: An employee worked more than twelve hours in one day (EA s.60A(7), s.60C(2)).
rules.description: EA s.60A(7) and s.60C(2) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): no employer shall require any employee to work more than twelve hours in any one day except in the s.60A(2)(a)–(e) emergencies.

rules.when: work.days.exists(d, d.intervals.exists(i, i.end != null && hours_between([i], "00:00", "00:00") > 5.0))
rules.message: An employee worked more than five consecutive hours without a 30-minute break (EA s.60A(1)(a)).
rules.description: EA s.60A(1)(a) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): not more than five consecutive hours without a period of leisure of at least thirty minutes (eight hours with 45 minutes for continuous work, proviso (ii)).

rules.when: work.days.exists(d, size(d.intervals.filter(i, i.end != null)) > 0 && [d.intervals.filter(i, i.end != null)].map(xs, size(xs) > 0 ? hours_between([{"start": xs[0].start, "end": xs[size(xs) - 1].end}], "00:00", "00:00") : 0.0)[0] > 10.0)
rules.message: A working day spread over more than ten hours (EA s.60A(1)(c)); the hours after the spread-over are overtime (s.60A(3)(b)).
rules.description: EA s.60A(1)(c) and (3)(b) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf).

rules.when: work.days.exists(d, d.day_type == "WORK" && d.scheduled_hours > 9.0) && !(has(terms.facts.shift_work) && terms.facts.shift_work == true)
rules.message: The planned normal hours exceed nine in a day (EA s.60A(1)(b) and proviso (iii)).
rules.description: EA s.60A(1)(b) and proviso (iii) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): eight hours a day, up to nine where other days of the week are shorter; shift work is averaged under s.60C.

rules.when: size(work.days) >= 7 && sum(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "WORK").map(d, d.scheduled_hours)) * 7.0 / double(size(work.days)) > 45.0
rules.message: The planned normal hours average more than 45 a week (EA s.60A(1)(d); s.60C(1) averages shift work over three weeks).
rules.description: EA s.60A(1)(d) and s.60C(1) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): not more than forty-five hours in one week; shift work may exceed it so long as the average over three weeks (or a longer approved period) does not.

rules.when: size(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "REST")) < size(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type != "")) / 7
rules.message: The plan gives fewer than one rest day a week (EA s.59(1)).
rules.description: EA s.59(1) and (1A) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): one whole rest day in each week, a continuous thirty hours for shift work.

rules.when: work.days.exists(d, d.holiday_kind in ["PUBLIC_HOLIDAY", "SUBSTITUTE", "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY"] && d.day_type == "REST")
rules.message: A public holiday fell on a rest day: the next working day is a paid holiday in its place (EA s.60D(1) proviso).
rules.description: EA s.60D(1) proviso and (1B) (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf): a holiday on a rest day or on another holiday moves to the next working day; one inside annual or sick leave is replaced by another day (leave chargeable days skip published holidays).

rules.when: !(term.employment_type == "PART_TIME" && has(term.facts.normal_hours_per_day)) && ((has(term.facts) && has(term.facts.pay_basis)) ? term.facts.pay_basis : "MONTHLY") == "DAILY" && term.base_salary > 0.0 && term.base_salary < (has(term.facts.days_per_week) && double(term.facts.days_per_week) <= 4.0 ? double(rules.minimum_wage.daily_four_day_week) : has(term.facts.days_per_week) && double(term.facts.days_per_week) == 5.0 ? double(rules.minimum_wage.daily_five_day_week) : double(rules.minimum_wage.daily_six_day_week))
rules.message: The daily rate is below the minimum wage for the working days a week (Minimum Wages Order 2024).
rules.description: Minimum Wages Order 2024 para 5(1) (https://gajiminimum.mohr.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/PUA%20376.pdf): RM65.38, RM78.46 or RM98.08 a day for a six-, five- or four-day week (terms.facts.days_per_week, six unrecorded). A part-timer with recorded normal hours a day is held to the hourly rate instead (MINIMUM_WAGE_HOURLY_PART_TIME).

rules.when: ((has(term.facts) && has(term.facts.pay_basis)) ? term.facts.pay_basis : "MONTHLY") == "WEEKLY" && term.employment_type != "PART_TIME" && term.base_salary > 0.0 && cel.bind(d, has(term.facts.days_per_week) ? double(term.facts.days_per_week) : 6.0, term.base_salary < d * (d <= 4.0 ? double(rules.minimum_wage.daily_four_day_week) : d == 5.0 ? double(rules.minimum_wage.daily_five_day_week) : double(rules.minimum_wage.daily_six_day_week)))
rules.message: The weekly rate is below the minimum wage: the daily minimum for the working days a week times those days (Minimum Wages Order 2024).
rules.description: Minimum Wages Order 2024 para 5(1) (https://gajiminimum.mohr.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/PUA%20376.pdf, read 2026-10-07): the Order states a monthly, a daily (by working days a week) and an hourly rate, not a weekly one; a week's wage is held to the daily rate for the week's working days — RM392.28 for six days (6 × 65.38), RM392.30 for five (5 × 78.46), RM392.32 for four (4 × 98.08); terms.facts.days_per_week, six unrecorded.

rules.when: ((has(term.facts) && has(term.facts.pay_basis)) ? term.facts.pay_basis : "MONTHLY") == "HOURLY" && term.base_salary > 0.0 && term.base_salary < double(rules.minimum_wage.hourly)
rules.message: The hourly rate is below RM8.72 (Minimum Wages Order 2024).
rules.description: Minimum Wages Order 2024 para 4 (https://gajiminimum.mohr.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/PUA%20376.pdf).

rules.when: (((has(terms.facts) && has(terms.facts.pay_basis)) ? terms.facts.pay_basis : "MONTHLY") == "PIECE" || terms.statutory_work_category == "TASK_BASIS") && (!has(period.parts) || period.part == period.parts) && employment.start_date <= period.month_from && (employment.exit_date == "" || employment.exit_date >= period.month_to) && payslip.gross + (has(earned.month.gross) ? earned.month.gross : 0.0) < double(rules.minimum_wage.monthly)
rules.message: A piece- or task-rated employee's month is below the RM1,700 minimum wage (Minimum Wages Order 2024 para 5).
rules.description: Minimum Wages Order 2024 para 5 (https://gajiminimum.mohr.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/PUA%20376.pdf): a piece, tonnage, task or commission rate is not less than the monthly minimum wage for a full month. The month is judged whole: on a sub-monthly entity (SEMI_MONTHLY, TEN_DAY, WEEKLY parts) the check runs on the month's last part over the month to date (this slip's gross plus earned.month.gross, the earlier parts), and only for a month the employment covers from its first to its last day — a half month is never compared with the monthly minimum (2026-10-08).

rules.when: !(company.pay_frequency in ["MONTHLY", "SEMI_MONTHLY", "TEN_DAY", "WEEKLY", ""])
rules.message: A wage period may not exceed one month (EA s.18).
rules.description: EA s.18 (https://lom.agc.gov.my/ilims/upload/portal/akta/outputaktap/1744567_BI/Reprint%20Act%20265%20(Final).pdf).
